title: Krytical Nova - Volume 3 (Flow)
note: Volume 3 (owner, 21 Oct 2026): one Selection theme per faction skin (the two kept and two takes of a third), and a wide spread of Cadence fight music so fights always feel exciting: faction flavours, hyperpop rush, half-time boss weight and breakbeat brawls. All from Flow (Lyria 3.5). New takes play from Flow's preview files; the full-quality WAVs replace them before anything goes in the game.

cues.tags: Third theme: Instrumental only, no vocals, no lyrics, no voices of any kind. Video game character select menu music, third theme of a set, darker and heavier than the others: epic war-drum djent meets trap, 100 BPM, D minor, 4/4. Huge tribal war drums and deep toms under heavy palm-muted 7-string guitar chugs locked to the kick, deep 808 sub bass, rolling trap hi-hats, a soaring lead guitar melody with a bowed-string feel, wide cinematic pads, defiant and heroic, mid intensity. Never jazz, never lo-fi, never cartoonish.

Six flavours, two takes each, all with a steady unchanging beat for Cadence: Hegemony cyber-djent (150, E minor), Null industrial djent (145, C minor), Covenant folk-metal djent (155, D minor), hyperpop metal rush (160, F# minor), half-time trap metal boss (140, C# minor), big-beat breakbeat punk (155, A minor). Plus the three kept from Volumes 1 and 2.
